title: phlegmariurus austroecuadoricus
intro: Phlegmariurus austroecuadoricus, commonly known as Ecuadorian forked polypody, is a type of plant belonging to the Lycopodiaceae family, characterized by its forked rhizome and leathery fronds. The health benefits associated with Phlegmariurus austroecuadoricus include its potential in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe coughs, and provide antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. Phlegmariurus austroecuadoricus contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
